title: Lesson 89: A Slip of the Tongue

segments.text: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
segments.translation: 那晚谁说了唯一一个好笑的笑话？为什么？

segments.text: People will do anything to see a free show--even if it is a bad one.
segments.translation: 人们为了看免费演出什么都愿意做——即使是一场糟糕的演出。

segments.text: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented
segments.translation: 当消息传开说有一场喜剧表演

segments.text: at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
segments.translation: 将由P.U.鸟食公司在我们当地的电影院上演时，我们都跑去看。

segments.text: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
segments.translation: 我们排了好几个小时的队才进去，就在演出开始前一定有好几百人在场。

segments.text: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
segments.translation: 不幸的是，这是我们看过的最乏味的演出之一。

segments.text: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed,
segments.translation: 那些没能进去的人不必感到失望，

segments.text: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
segments.translation: 因为许多本应出场的艺术家都没有来。

segments.text: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
segments.translation: 那晚我们听到的唯一有趣的事情来自节目开始时的广告员。

segments.text: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
segments.translation: 他显然非常紧张，在麦克风前尴尬地站了好几分钟。

segments.text: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
segments.translation: 他一张嘴，大家就大笑起来。

segments.text: We all know what the poor man should have said,
segments.translation: 我们都知道这个可怜的人应该说什么，

segments.text: but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company. Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
segments.translation: 但他实际上说的是：'这是普伊籽鸟公司。好女士们，晚上好先生们！'
